cli.description: Nagios plugin loogu talagalay hubinta qiimaha Bitcoin
cli.epilog:
Tusaalooyin:
  %(prog)s
    Hubi qiimaha Bitcoin iyadoon lahayn xad (qiimayaasha saxda ah waxay soo celiyaan OK)

  %(prog)s -w 30000:50000 -c 25000:60000
    Digniin haddii qiimuhu ka hooseeyo 30000 ama ka sarreeyo 50000
    Halis haddii qiimuhu ka hooseeyo 25000 ama ka sarreeyo 60000

  %(prog)s --warning-low 30000 --critical-low 25000
    Digniin bixi oo keliya marka qiimuhu hoos u dhaco

  %(prog)s --currency eur
    Hubi qiimaha iyadoo lagu xisaabinayo EUR halkii laga isticmaali lahaa USD
cli.fallback_url_help: Barta dhammaadka dheeraadka ah ee la jaanqaada CoinGecko (waa lagu celin karaa)
cli.lang_help: Koodhka luqadda ee fariimaha plugin-ka (wuxuu beddelaa LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG)
cli.max_age_help: Da'da ugu badan ee qiimaha iyadoo ah ilbiriqsi; waxay u baahan tahay waqtiga bixiyaha (caadi ahaan: {default} marka qiimuhu leeyahay waqti-calaamad)
cli.move_window_help: Muddada dhaqdhaqaaqa iyadoo ah ilbiriqsi (caadi ahaan: 3600)
cli.retries_help: Isku-dayo ku-celin ku-meel-gaar ah (0-5; caadi ahaan: 1)
cli.state_file_help: Taariikhda JSON ee dhaqdhaqaaqa muddada gaaban
cli.timeout_help: Waqtiga kama dambaysta ah ee wadarta codsiga/ku-celinta iyadoo ah ilbiriqsi (caadi ahaan: {default})
